scoring_justification: True saddle points of the analytic potential are derived analytically; the checker compares agent-reported transition states to these gold saddles using distance and energy tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference set of true saddle points for the synthetic potential used by the Bubble algorithm.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived analytically from the given synthetic potential function f(x,y,z) = -cos(2πx/Lx) - cos(2πy/Ly) - cos(2πz/Lz), with Lx=5 Å, Ly=10 Å, Lz=5 Å.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Saddle points are located at the halfway points between periodic images of the global minimum along each Cartesian direction; coordinates and energies computed directly from the function.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are exact solutions to ∇f=0 for the periodic potential, providing an authoritative reference for the approximate transition states found by the Bubble algorithm.

outputs.description: List of distinct approximate transition states found by the Bubble flooding algorithm on the synthetic periodic potential. The checker matches each reported state to a precomputed set of true saddle points within coordinate and energy tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The synthetic analytic potential function is supplied in the instruction. The Bubble algorithm must be implemented by the agent; no external Bubble code or precomputed grid is provided. The output must contain all distinct diffusion directions (at least three for a 3D unit cell).
